data.title: Palmiera 2 The Oasis
data.about:
Following the successful launch of Palmiera and Palmiera 2, Emaar has launched a new series of villas in the development. Palmiera 3 consists of meticulously crafted 4-bedroom villas with private pools and communal facilities like a gym, children's play areas, and resident clubhouses.

Located in The Oasis by Emaar, Palmiera has over 7,000 grand residences built in phases. These homes are set amidst lush green spaces and beautiful canals, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding area. Palmiera at The Oasis offers proximity to major transportation routes, such as D54 and E44, and Al Maktoum International Airport is a short drive away.

location_tile.title: The Most Convenient Location in Dubailand
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Oasis, situated in the southeast of Dubai's dynamic heart, embodies the essence of luxury living. Once celebrated for its serene landscapes and equestrian culture, this scenic region is being transformed by a growing number of high-end developments that bolster Dubai's reputation in the luxury real estate market.

The Oasis Palmiera 2 is located in Dubailand, a district set to be twice the size of Walt Disney World. This massive development is divided into six distinct zones: Attractions and Experience World, Sports and Outdoor World, Eco-Tourism World, Themed Leisure and Vacation World, Retail and Entertainment World, and Downtown, making it the world's largest collection of theme parks.

  • 18 Mins to Al Maktoum International Airport 
  • 20 Mins to Dubai Hills  / Dubai Hills Estate
  • 28 Mins to Dubai Marina & Dubai Marina Mall
  • 35 Mins to Downtown Dubai & Dubai Mall

more_info.answer: Palmiera at The Oasis offers two flexible payment plans: the Palmiera 2 plan with a 90/10 structure, where you pay 10% upfront and 90% upon completion, and the Palmiera 3 plan with an 80/20 structure, where 80% is paid during construction and 20% at handover.
